# Meet Patel (themeetpatel)

> Meet Patel — also known as The Meet Patel, themeetpatel, and "the startup guy" — is a startup founder and operator based in Dubai, UAE. He runs the venture studio Biggventure (Biggventures) and is currently building Company 8 (Company8), the AI-native business intelligence company behind useDan. This is his personal site: bio, ventures, essays on startup operations, and contact.

Key facts:

- Name: Meet Patel. Handles: themeetpatel, The Meet Patel, @the_meetpatel.
- Known as: "the startup guy" in the UAE startup ecosystem.
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
- Roles: startup founder, operator, venture builder.
- Venture studio: Biggventure (founded 2022, Dubai) — builds, ships, and scales startups across AI, fintech, hardware, and software.
- Current venture: Company 8 — AI-native business intelligence, maker of useDan ("Ask your business anything. Get answers that lead to action.").
- Track record: built and scaled 10+ ventures.
- Canonical site: https://www.themeetpatel.com
